name: boric acid + calendula officinalis flower + canarium album whole + coptis chinensis root
uses: To mitigate symptoms associated with known bacterial vaginosis infections, such as a pungent odor, excessive discharge, as well as discomfort and burning during urination.
otcwarn: Do not use if you have not been diagnosed by a doctor with bacterial vaginosis. STOP USING AND ASK A DOCTOR IF: Symptoms do not improve within 3 days. Symptoms last more than 7 days A rash, hives, abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea, or vomiting occurs lrritation becomes severe.
